body: SCOUT CHECKPOINT — bd-01M169CNQT6WWBQXRF2YT239M0 (P1) is now first in my queue; the accepted new-route-metrics bead remains claimed but unedited. I am reserving metrics.scala plus the focused MetricsSuite and WogDiagnosticSuite paths, retiring the broken ID, and adding a production-path fixture regression under the chief's ADR 0003 ruling.
